facts.fact: Ley Núm. 1/2016 of 22 July 2016, sanctioned and promulgated by the President, sets rules for personal data processing in the public and private sectors and enters into force twenty days after its publication in the Boletín Oficial del Estado (date taken from the law's own date, 22 July 2016).
facts.system: Ley Núm. 1/2016, de Protección de Datos Personales

facts.fact: Articles 15 and 29 name the Órgano Rector de Protección de Datos Personales as the supervisory body, with a Secretaría Técnica and a Registro General under it, but state that it is to be created by a decree that will fix its structure.
facts.system: Órgano Rector de Protección de Datos Personales
